purpose: Govern legal-document structure, versioning, notarial discipline, statutory handling, and counsel review without replacing legal advice.
human_note: The kernel governs process, not law.
counsel_rule: Use qualified Philippine counsel for legal advice, enforceability conclusions, statutory interpretation, and final review of material agreements.

cmsa.name: Client Master Services Agreement
cmsa.purpose: Signed once per client; POs, NTPs and SOWs reference it.

smsa.name: Supplier Master Sourcing Agreement
smsa.purpose: Signed once per supplier; purchase instruments reference it.

framework.payment_tiers: Inherit from the authoritative master and 06 unless the signed instrument says otherwise.
framework.nda: Recorded five-year tail default; preserve trade-secret treatment as applicable.
framework.non_circumvention: Recorded 24-month default subject to competition-law carve-outs.
framework.force_majeure: Preserve strict authoritative wording; no casual expansion.
framework.competition: Narrow restrictions to what is necessary; use authoritative wording.

secretary_certificate.signatory: Michael C. Silla as Corporate Secretary
secretary_certificate.notarial_form: Acknowledgment unless the instrument legally requires otherwise.
secretary_certificate.identity_evidence: Record competent evidence as required by the notary and operative rules.

regulatory.invoice_phrase: THIS DOCUMENT IS NOT VALID FOR CLAIM OF INPUT TAX
regulatory.authority_to_print: Use current BIR forms, accredited-printer requirements, filing instructions, and authoritative certificate master.
regulatory.verification: Verify current statutory references before filing.
regulatory.tax_rate_language: Never state that a domestic corporation exercises the 8% income-tax option. For Non-VAT percentage tax, use the registered form and current law, and avoid presenting a tax rate as permanently fixed.
regulatory.corporate_authority: Do not treat a job title, signature block, profile, or filename as proof of authority. Require the governing corporate record.
regulatory.privacy: Personal TINs, residential addresses, IDs, and beneficial-ownership details are restricted internal data and must not be copied into public or routine client materials.

formatting.default: Use authoritative legal master; recorded convention includes long bond, Times New Roman 11pt, justified, 1.5 spacing and controlled margins where required.
formatting.pt_exception: Quotation px rules do not override legal-master typography.

hard_stops: do not assert enforceability without counsel
do not alter statutory language casually
do not present the kernel as legal advice
failure_modes: blank TIN left in final legal derivative
superseded identifier copied from an older registration source
candidate master called executed or lawyer-approved without evidence

corporate_identifiers.rule: Populate legal derivatives from 01_identity canonical data; never copy an identifier from a superseded registration source.

existing_candidate_masters.reason: Existing final-labeled file; retain counsel/notarial review gate and update any blank or outdated corporate identifier before use.
